title: BrainIAC on BraTS: analysis code, split and results
description: Analysis scripts (two-level bootstrap, per-seed t-tests, Holm correction, failure decomposition), the case-level split (case identifiers only) and per-run and per-case results for the BrainIAC fine-tuning study on BraTS 2023 GLI, BraTS-PEDs and BraTS-Africa. No imaging data are included.
